description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Calling for claims to property of intestate in Magammana, Homagama D/S Division, Homagama, Colombo  District   - Cad. Map No. 520003 and 05 other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land registration information including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers for multiple properties. The content focuses on land title settlement and property inheritance claims, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
